svg.title: Shadow Jog roadmap
svg.desc: Order and dependency only. Bar length is not time. Now: no milestone. Items in the same column can run in parallel. Foundations: Phase 0 Platform spike (done), Pre-M0 640x360 move (done), M0 Prepare (done). Engine path: M1 Shell (done), M2 Effects (done), M3 Battle stage (done), M5 Field (done), M6 Flip default (done), M7 3D mode (done), M8a UI kit and data (done), M8b UI scenes (done), M8c Battle and field (done), M8d Delete old engine (done). Side paths: M1b 3D proof (done), M4 UI scenes (done), ET Editor port (done), Editors Editor suite (later). Epics before a demo Mark can share: P101 Chapter 1 playthrough (next), E4 Engine docs (next), E1 2D art and maps (next), E2 3D hacking mode (next), E3 Editor suite (next), Demo Final demo (later). Needs Mark's go-ahead: archive-tags Archive tags (gated), release-tags Release tags (gated), deploy Deploy site (gated). Other open items (no order): playthrough-notes Playthrough notes edit (next), pixellab-end PixelLab end date (done), sprite-fusion Sprite credits (optional), cc-followups CC follow-ups (optional), plasma-bug plasma-ui bug report (optional).
svg.text: Order and dependency only. Bar length is not time.
READ LEFT TO RIGHT. A COLUMN IS A STEP IN THE ORDER. ITEMS IN ONE COLUMN CAN RUN IN PARALLEL. DATA UPDATED 2026-10-16.
EPICS BEFORE A DEMO MARK CAN SHARE

g.title: Phase 0 Platform spike: done. Mark approved the final engine design on 2026-10-05. Record: docs/spikes/engine-platform.md.
Pre-M0 640x360 move: done. The shipped game plays at 640x360. Record: docs/PIVOT-640.md.
M0 Prepare: done. Size module, bundle gate, canary suite, lab, agent docs. CI runs no timing gate; perf is local (npm run perf).
M1 Shell: done. Loop, renderer, scene stack, LegacyScene adapter. Behind the ?engine=sje flag. Merged in PR #46; GPU line held.

M2 Effects: done. FxSystem with the postfx facade, composite filter, particles. GPU timing check (npm run perf) once at the end, not in CI. Built on branch engine-m2-effects; GPU line held (2026-10-09).

M3 Battle stage: done. The side-battle rebuild landed here. Spike PRs #3 (side-battle) and #4 (phaser-stage) stay open as references and never merge. GPU timing check (npm run perf) done once at the end on an RTX 4070 (2026-10-10): live battle interval p95 18.10 ms against bare 18.10, cost p95 3.40 ms; the speed line held.
M5 Field: done. Field map, actors, camera, lights, weather. Mark approves the lighting. GPU timing check (npm run perf) once at the end, not in CI.

M6 Flip default: done. ?engine=sje becomes the default. The old presenter goes. M4 joins here if it is built. It is optional (dashed arrow). GPU timing check (npm run perf) once at the end, not in CI.
M7 3D mode: done. Needs both the 3D proof (M1b) and the default flip (M6). GPU timing check (npm run perf) once at the end, not in CI.

ET Editor port: done. Merged 2026-10-14 (PR #86), before M8. Every editor and tool moved to the new engine; the Battle Stage Editor (/stageedit.html) and Battle Test are back. The trailer is deleted (#84). Two exceptions until M8d: the Battle Test glue module and the shared old Input. Record: docs/engine/et-brief.md.

M8a UI kit and data: done. Merged 2026-10-14 (PR #94). The UI kit is in src/sje/ui (TextObject, NineSlice, ListMenu, bar, cursor), and the shop and dialogue content moved to data files. Mark ran the GPU timing check (npm run perf) on 2026-10-14: it passed. Record: docs/engine/m8-brief.md.
M8b UI scenes: done. Port the 13 UI scenes to native scenes, small to big. All 13 are native. Merged in PR #95 (2026-10-15). Follows the diff rule for the GPU timing check.
M8c Battle and field: done. Port the battle and field scenes. Merged in PR #96 (2026-10-15).

M8d Delete old engine: done. Delete the old engine, LegacyScene and the exemptions. Move the kept src/engine files into src/sje. Docs and the PR #86 follow-ups. Merged in PR #98 (6bf70cf, 2026-10-16); the old engine and src/engine are gone. GPU timing check passed.
M1b 3D proof: done. Parallel with M2. A spinning cube in a Scene3D, with the hand-off, leak and loss tests.
M4 UI scenes: done. Closed 2026-10-16 (Mark). M8b and M8c ported all 13 UI scenes and the battle and field scenes to native sje scenes, so nothing is left to port.

archive-tags Archive tags: gated. archive/side-battle-<date> and archive/phaser-stage-<date>, then close PRs #3 and #4. Mark approves each tag. They wait until M3 lands (status.md, Next for agents 3).
release-tags Release tags: gated. Annotated v* tags. Cut only after Mark's playtest and go-ahead. Not tied to one milestone. The column is only a place on the chart.

deploy Deploy site: gated. Site: shadowjog.com. The last alpha step, with the secure email sign-up. Only with Mark's explicit go-ahead. Not tied to one milestone. The column is only a place on the chart.
playthrough-notes Playthrough notes edit: next. Mark's uncommitted edit to docs/mark-playthrough-notes.md waits for him.
pixellab-end PixelLab end date: done. Decided 2026-10-16 (Mark): PixelLab is out. New 2D art comes from Sprite Fusion or other sources.
sprite-fusion Sprite credits: optional. Sprite Fusion is now the main art source (PixelLab is out, 2026-10-16). Credits go to the art epic E1.
cc-followups CC follow-ups: optional. Command Center items left over (status.md, Next for agents 1b). All optional.
plasma-bug plasma-ui bug report: optional. An upstream bug report for the plasma-ui canvas width (R28), if Mark wants one.

Editors Editor suite: later. After Chapter 1. New UI editors so Mark builds the game mostly in tools: troops, database, maps, conversations, animation composer, lights and weather. Plan: docs/TOOLING-UI.md section 4.

P101 Chapter 1 playthrough: next. Step 1. Mark plays Chapter 1, then fixes, release and deploy. Issue https://github.com/markhazlewood42/shadow-jog/issues/101. No epic starts before #101 closes. Next: Mark answers the epic decisions, then plays.

E1 2D art and maps: next. Approved 2026-10-16. Brief: https://github.com/markhazlewood42/shadow-jog/issues/102. Decisions: #106 to #111. Step 3: WS0 to WS2 (decisions, style checker, tileset format). WS3 to WS5 follow in step 4. Waits on #101.

E2 3D hacking mode: next. Approved 2026-10-16. Brief: https://github.com/markhazlewood42/shadow-jog/issues/103. Decisions: #112 to #119. Step 3: WS-A feel prototype beside E1. WS-B to WS-F follow in step 4. Waits on #101.

E3 Editor suite: next. Approved 2026-10-16. Brief: https://github.com/markhazlewood42/shadow-jog/issues/104. Decisions: #120 to #126. W0 to W3 in step 4. W4 to W5 in step 5. W5 waits for the approved E1 map format doc.

E4 Engine docs: next. Approved 2026-10-16. Brief: https://github.com/markhazlewood42/shadow-jog/issues/105. Decisions: #127 to #132. Step 2: the comment standard and stale CLAUDE.md lines first. The rest runs beside the other epics. Waits on #101.
Demo Final demo: later. Step 6. A final integrated playthrough and demo release. Owner: a follow-up issue. Demo cut: #101 + E1 + E2.

svg.text: NEXT Starts next, or waits for Mark
